en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small European town bordered by open, gently rolling farmland. In the foreground are tiled‑roof houses and a few larger masonry buildings, one of them an ornate multi‑storey structure with dormer windows and decorative gables. A narrow river or canal with stone embankments runs through the town, crossed by a modest bridge. Industrial elements are visible, including tall brick chimneys and a rectangular factory‑like building. Beyond the clustered houses, a straight tree‑lined road leads out into patterned agricultural fields stretching to the horizon. The overall scene is semi‑rural with a mix of residential and light industrial architecture. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
